phase: First neural run active; no final evaluation yet
persistence: Last observed XRP close at each identical origin; exact same origin+24 target
configuration_selection: Lowest mean validation price RMSE across all five seeds per neural configuration; ARIMAX selected order validation RMSE. Choose minimum across fitted configurations, excluding persistence and GARCH. No evaluation metric enters selection.
seed_selection: All five seeds reported. Representative checkpoint is lowest validation RMSE within selected neural configuration; ties use seed order in frozen protocol.
rolling: Fresh weights and fitting-only scalers per fold; chronological earlier validation; no parameter carryover from main or other folds
benchmark_direction: Constant-price forecast predicts zero movement. Exact three-way sign accuracy includes actual zero returns; report separately from non-flat directional forecasting.
